Coverage_Description: Hospital and surgical cover with a shared HK$5,000,000 annual benefit pool per policy; full cover at Bupa network providers in Hong Kong (subject to terms) or non-network reimbursement at 80% (Plan A, 20% coinsurance) / 100% (Plan B, 0% coinsurance); area of cover: Asia, Australia and New Zealand
pricing: Hospital and Surgical discounted premium per person (age 41): single enrolment Plan A HK$11,845/year (HK$1,066/month), Plan B HK$13,474/year (HK$1,213/month); family enrolment discounts give age-41 Plan A HK$10,068/year (2 persons) or HK$9,476/year (3+ persons). Optional benefits
